verdict.rationale: QuickBooks documents 'Intuit Intelligence' chat and AI features that generate insights (e.g., 'Ask anything—from What's driving my profit? ... get instant, contextual answers', suggested reports on top expenses/sales trends/benchmarking, anomaly resolution, and Payroll AI spotting inconsistencies), directly matching the story of AI-generated insights/suggestions from data. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user corroboration of the Intuit Intelligence insights feature (community evidence only covers pricing/reliability complaints, not AI insight quality).
